235:     for (std::string& word : tokenize(query)) {
236:         if (seen_words.insert(word).second) {

257:

259:             book_match_counts[book_id]++;

264:     for (const auto& [book_id, count] : book_match_counts) {
265:         if (count == words.size()) {

267:         }
268:     }
269: 
270:     if (matched_books.empty()) {
271:         return {};
272:     }
273: 
274:     std::vector<Index> matches;
275:     for (const std::string& word : words) {
276:         const auto& indices = inverted_index.at(word);
277: 
278:         for (const Index& index : indices) {
279:             if (matched_books.contains(index.book_id)) {
280:                 matches.push_back(index);

290: std::vector<Index> SearchEngine::search_phrase(std::string_view query) const {
291:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
292:     if (words.empty()) {
293:         return {};
294:     }
295: 
296:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(words.front());
297:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end()) {
298:         return {};
299:     }
300: 
301:     std::vector<Index> matches;
302:     for (const Index& start : first_word->second) {
303:         std::vector<Index> phrase_match{start};
304:         bool is_phrase = true;
305: 
306:         for (size_t offset = 1; offset < words.size(); ++offset) {
307:             const auto found = inverted_index.find(words[offset]);
308:             if (found == inverted_index.end()) {
309:                 return {};
310:             }
311: 
312:             const auto next = std::ranges::find_if(found->second, [&](const Index& index) {
313:                 return index.book_id == start.book_id && index.line == start.line &&
314:                        index.word_idx == start.word_idx + offset;
315:             });
316: 
317:             if (next == found->second.end()) {
318:                 is_phrase = false;
319:                 break;
320:             }
321: 
322:             phrase_match.push_back(*next);
323:         }
324: 
325:         if (is_phrase) {
326:             matches.insert(matches.end(), phrase_match.begin(), phrase_match.end());
327:         }
328:     }
329: 
330:     std::ranges::sort(matches, {}, cmpr);
331:     return matches;
332: }

418: std::vector<Index> SearchEngine::search_near(std::string_view query, size_t dis) const {
419:     const std::vector<std::string> words = tokenize(query);
420:     if (words.empty()) {
421:         return {};

423: 
424:     if (words.size() == 1) {
425:         return search_or(query);
426:     }
427: 
428:     const std::string& word1 = words[0];
429:     const std::string& word2 = words[1];
430: 
431:     const auto first_word = inverted_index.find(word1);
432:     const auto second_word = inverted_index.find(word2);
433:     if (first_word == inverted_index.end() || second_word == inverted_index.end()) {
434:         return {};
435:     }
436: 
437:     std::vector<Index> matches;
438: 
439:     for (const Index& first : first_word->second) {
440:         for (const Index& second : second_word->second) {
441:             if (first.book_id != second.book_id || first.line != second.line) {
442:                 continue;
443:             }
444: 
445:             const size_t distance = first.word_idx > second.word_idx
446:                                         ? first.word_idx - second.word_idx
447:                                         : second.word_idx - first.word_idx;
448:             if (distance <= dis) {
449:                 matches.push_back(first);
450:                 matches.push_back(second);
451:             }
452:         }
453:     }

460: Context get_context_range(const std::vector<Book>& books, const Index& idx) {
461:     if (idx.book_id >= books.size()) {
462:         return {};
463:     }
464:     const Book& book = books[idx.book_id];
465: 
466:     if (idx.line >= book.lines.size() || is_blank_line(book.lines[idx.line])) {
467:         return {};
468:     }
469:     size_t cur_begin = idx.line;
470: 
471:     while (cur_begin > 0 && !is_blank_line(book.lines[cur_begin - 1])) {
472:         cur_begin--;
473:     }
474: 
475:     size_t cur_end = idx.line + 1;
476:     while (cur_end < book.lines.size() && !is_blank_line(book.lines[cur_end])) {
477:         cur_end++;
478:     }
479: 
480:     Context context{
481:         .cur = LineRange{.begin = cur_begin, .end = cur_end},
482:     };
483: 
484:     size_t prev_end = cur_begin;
485:     while (prev_end > 0 && is_blank_line(book.lines[prev_end - 1])) {
486:         --prev_end;
487:     }
488: 
489:     size_t prev_begin = prev_end;
490:     while (prev_begin > 0 && !is_blank_line(book.lines[prev_begin - 1])) {
491:         --prev_begin;
492:     }
493: 
494:     if (prev_begin < prev_end) {
495:         context.prev = LineRange{.begin = prev_begin, .end = prev_end};
496:     }
497: 
498:     size_t next_begin = cur_end;
499:     while (next_begin < book.lines.size() && is_blank_line(book.lines[next_begin])) {
500:         ++next_begin;
501:     }
502: 
503:     size_t next_end = next_begin;
504:     while (next_end < book.lines.size() && !is_blank_line(book.lines[next_end])) {
505:         ++next_end;
506:     }
507: 
508:     if (next_begin < next_end) {
509:         context.next = LineRange{.begin = next_begin, .end = next_end};
510:     }
511: 
512:     return context;
513: }
